body:
Hey there,

I encountered the following error when the video frames are rendered. I used AR1 model with reasoning overlay.

runtime-0-1     | Error rendering video: 'RenderableTrajectory' object has no attribute 'poses'
runtime-0-1     | Stacktrace: Traceback (most recent call last):
runtime-0-1     |   File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video.py", line 155, in render_video_from_eval_result
runtime-0-1     |     render_and_save_video(
runtime-0-1     |   File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video.py", line 89, in render_and_save_video
runtime-0-1     |     render_reasoning_overlay_style_video(
runtime-0-1     |   File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video_reasoning_overlay_utils.py", line 545, in render_reasoning_overlay_style_video
runtime-0-1     |     combined_frame = _render_single_reasoning_overlay_frame(
runtime-0-1     |                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
runtime-0-1     |   File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video_reasoning_overlay_utils.py", line 448, in _render_single_reasoning_overlay_frame
runtime-0-1     |     ego_qvec = ego_pose_at_time.poses[0]
runtime-0-1     |                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
runtime-0-1     | AttributeError: 'RenderableTrajectory' object has no attribute 'poses'

I noticed the changes to eval/src/data.py in d175589, however it seems the changes in video_reasoning_overlay_utils.py were not included in the commit.

comments.body: Thank you for reporting, looking into it! Currently travelling so might only be merged next week.

Is this issue resolved ? Because I see error too. The reasoning overlay video is written but it is corrupt, can't open it. 

Is there any local solution ? @maximilianigl

This specific crash should now be fixed on current `main`. The reasoning overlay renderer now uses the `RenderableTrajectory` API directly rather than accessing `.poses`, and there is a regression test for this path.

I’m going to close this issue as fixed. If anyone is still seeing corrupt reasoning-overlay MP4 output on latest `main`, please open a new issue with the exact command, AlpaSim commit, and video/log output, since that appears to be a separate video writer/codec problem.
